name: Aider
author: Aider-AI
one_liner: A terminal coding assistant that runs your linter and test command after each edit and asks the model to fix failures.

loop.judged_by: Your lint command and test command (non-zero exit code means failure)
loop.steers: Failure output is fed back so the model repairs the edit

not_proved: A clean lint and test run shows only that those checks pass. Behavior the tests do not cover is unchecked, and the tests are only as good as you made them.
